title: Hele-Shaw Flow With Pressure and Shear Rate Dependent Viscosity
summary: This paper investigates the behaviour of a fluid characterized by a viscosity simultaneously depending on pressure and shear rate within a Hele-Shaw cell featuring a sharp corner geometry. The study extends previous analyses conducted on purely pressure-dependent (piezo-viscous) and yield-stress fluids, providing a new perspective on confined complex flows.
